headline: Samsung and SK Hynix Upgrading China Plants for Advanced Chips
summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are upgrading their China plants to manufacture flash NAND memory chips with more than 200 layers.
why: Samsung and SK Hynix are dominant global memory chip producers, and their manufacturing upgrades in China affect supply chains for electronics and data storage.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Upgrading production lines to high-layer memory increases advanced chip output capacity.
